title: Tiramisu Cake
description: A classic Italian dessert, this Tiramisu Cake is made with espresso-soaked ladyfingers, creamy mascarpone cheese, and cocoa powder. Perfect for any coffee lover.

ingredients.name: Ladyfingers
ingredients.notes: Italian ladyfingers are best for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Mascarpone cheese
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use high-quality mascarpone cheese.

ingredients.name: Cocoa powder
ingredients.notes: Use Dutch-processed cocoa powder for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Strong brewed coffee
ingredients.notes: Espresso or strong brewed coffee works best for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Granulated sugar
ingredients.notes: Adjust the amount of sugar to your taste.

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the mascarpone cheese, granulated sugar, and eggs. Mix until smooth.
2. Add the cocoa powder to the mascarpone mixture and mix until well combined.
3. Dip each ladyfinger into the strong brewed coffee for about 3-5 seconds on each side. They should be soft and pliable but not too wet.
4. In a large serving dish, create a layer of ladyfingers. You can trim them to fit the dish.
5. Spread half of the mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers.
6. Repeat the layers, starting with the ladyfingers, then the mascarpone mixture.
7. Dust the top of the cake with cocoa powder.
8. Cover the cake with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight.
9. Slice the cake into thick slices and serve.
